meta.title: SCIM 2.0 (HRMS Sync): on failure — failed SCIM events are queued and retried
gaps: Configure the SCIM 2.0 integration with the specified base URL, bearer token, attribute mapping, and deprovision action
Make the external SCIM service fail or become unreachable
Trigger a user create, update, or deprovision event in the external HRMS
Observe evidence that the failed SCIM event was queued and retried, including its state, alert, log, or retry record, and verify it was not silently dropped
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the SCIM 2.0 integration with the specified base URL, bearer token, attribute mapping, and deprovision action; Make the external SCIM service fail or become unreachable; Trigger a user create, update, or deprovision event in the external HRMS; Observe evidence that the failed SCIM event was queued and retried, including its state, alert, log, or retry record, and verify it was not silently dropped

args.need: configure the SCIM 2.0 integration, make the external SCIM service fail or become unreachable, trigger an HRMS user lifecycle event, and verify from the available integration state, alert, log, or retry record that the failed event was queued and retried rather than dropped

steps.note: The catalog cannot perform or observe this integration-specific failure and retry workflow.
Checks that the resulting screen is not crashed or showing a generic server error, but does not establish SCIM queue or retry handling.
